acceptance: morize-core exports RelationEdgeClass from the existing relation module with exactly Explicit and Inferred as current variants and no additional current edge class.
RelationEdgeClass is a closed vocabulary for this Grain and is not marked non_exhaustive; future edge-class expansion requires a separate compatibility-governed Grain.
Both RelationEdgeClass variants are fieldless, and neither Explicit nor Inferred defines evidence sufficiency, truth, authority, graph mutation, memory mutation, or authorization behavior.
RelationEdgeClass supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests exercise both variants and confirm distinct value semantics without defining an ordering contract.

The implementation defines no relation endpoints, evidence references, engine identity, confidence, inference/evidence thresholds, graph behavior, Display, FromStr, parser, serde integration, numeric repr/discriminants, or wire/persistence format.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and includes focused tests for both relation edge classes and required value semantics.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain admits no runtime, build, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for exact Explicit/Inferred fidelity, closed-vocabulary correctness, absence of inference-policy/authority/graph/wire semantics, scope containment, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisites for SG-000011 and SG-000019 revalidate against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.
The implementation changes no path outside crates/morize-core/src/relation.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free closed in-memory RelationEdgeClass enum, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No relation endpoints, evidence references, engine identity, confidence, inference thresholds, graph behavior, authorization, serialization, persistence, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, exact Explicit/Inferred fidelity, closed-vocabulary correctness, absence of inference-policy/authority/graph/wire semantics, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the relation-edge-class implementation commits; no persisted format, graph state, inference policy, authorization rule, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: One standard-library-only two-variant enum in the existing relation module is the narrowest implementation of the already-fixed explicit/inferred distinction while deferring relation structure, thresholds, inference behavior, serialization, and persistence.

requirements: RelationEdgeClass is descriptive provenance classification only; Inferred must not itself imply evidence sufficiency, truth, authority, authorization, or permission to mutate memory or graph state.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free closed RelationEdgeClass enum with exactly Explicit and Inferred as fixed by docs/DATA_MODEL.md, without defining relation endpoints, evidence sufficiency, inference thresholds, graph behavior, authorization, serialization, persistence, or policy effects.
rationale: docs/DATA_MODEL.md fixes every MemoryRelation edge_class as explicit or inferred, and MZ-PROV-005 requires inferred graph relationships to identify their inference/evidence class. This Grain adds only the typed edge-class distinction so later relation structure and inference-policy Grains can build on a bounded primitive without inventing thresholds or graph semantics.

risk.recovery: Revert the relation-edge-class implementation commits; no persisted format, graph state, inference policy, authorization rule, or user data has been written by this Grain.

scope_in: Define public closed RelationEdgeClass with exactly Explicit and Inferred, matching docs/DATA_MODEL.md edge_class = explicit | inferred.

Keep both variants fieldless and derive only Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash so edge class is typed without defining ordering, textual/numeric encoding, evidence sufficiency, confidence, or policy semantics.

Treat Explicit and Inferred as descriptive provenance classification only; neither value itself grants authority, proves truth, establishes evidence sufficiency, authorizes mutation, or triggers graph behavior.
Add standard-library-only focused tests covering both values, distinct equality/hash semantics, and Copy behavior without serialization or parser contracts.
scope_out: A MemoryRelation struct, RelationId composition, from_ref/to_ref endpoints, evidence_refs, engine identity, confidence, policy revision binding, or inference/evidence thresholds.
Graph traversal or mutation, relationship discovery, inference engines, conflict/supersession policy, truth/authority semantics, authorization, or any behavior inferred merely from RelationEdgeClass.

Display/FromStr, parsers, serde or other serialization integration, numeric repr/discriminants, persisted or wire encoding, configuration formats, migrations, storage, retrieval, or domain-record integration.
Any third-party runtime, build, or test dependency.
